reasoning: This is an abstract UI directional/gesture glyph (move up from point / swipe up) with no concrete real-world object. At small task-list sizes it looks like an inverted or stylized exclamation mark, and tasks involving 'upload' or 'upgrade' are much better served by standard cloud-upload or object-specific icons.
